notes.text: Light dashboards come closest: opening a view is quick, and live updates and more-info dialogs are fluid. It slows down: light takes 480 ms to answer a tap, typical without a camera blocks for 4.5 s after it is drawn, and typical with a camera has a camera stream that shows no frame. On heavy, the page was lost in 3 of 3 runs: the panel ran out of memory and its browser page was closed (low-memory killer).
